display_long_description:
Fruit Ninja VR: Ghostbusters is a fast-paced VR arcade action game that combines classic fruit-slicing gameplay with supernatural ghost-hunting chaos in an immersive virtual reality world.

Step into the role of a high-tech ninja exorcist equipped with proton-powered blades and advanced VR motion controls. Your mission is simple: slice everything in your path. Chop flying fruit with precision, unleash combo streaks, and battle waves of paranormal entities invading haunted locations.

From glowing fruit storms to terrifying ghost swarms, every level challenges your reflexes, accuracy, and speed. Use your VR controllers to swing, slash, and perform powerful combo attacks while dodging cursed objects and dangerous spectral traps.

Face increasingly difficult waves of enemies, including powerful boss ghosts that require timing, strategy, and skill to defeat. Team up with friends in co-op mode or test your endurance in endless survival challenges.

Key Features:
Immersive VR motion-based slicing gameplay
Classic fruit-slicing action combined with ghost battles
Fast-paced arcade combat and combo scoring system
Paranormal boss fights with unique attack patterns
Haunted environments and cinematic effects
Co-op multiplayer and survival modes
Smooth, responsive VR controls for full immersion

Whether you’re slicing fruit at lightning speed or fighting off waves of angry spirits, Fruit Ninja VR: Ghostbusters delivers an intense, energetic VR experience built for action lovers and arcade
